dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible in the central cluster are four 'O' shaped structures with high-contrast, serrated dark perimeters transitioning abruptly to light grey interiors; a large 'C' shaped structure on the lower flank exhibits a more diffuse outer gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid, high-intensity (light) pixel clusters in the anterior neck region; scattered low-intensity (dark) solid blobs are interspersed between the macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent central rings form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented towards the anterior; a secondary set of four rings in the lower-mid region forms an irregular parallelogram.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several short, high-contrast linear streaks resembling superficial scratches are visible along the lower anterior edge; a localized dark indentation is present on the far posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique overlapping configuration where two macro-annuli intersect to form a figure-eight pattern in the lower central quadrant of the visible flank.
